channel.title: Shotter Updates
channel.description: Most recent changes with links to updates.

item.title: Version 1.7.3
item.description:
What's Fixed in 1.7.3

  • Hotkeys: Fixed event pass-through ownership so other apps no longer see phantom ⌘⇧3/4/5 presses
  • Save reliability: Direct-copy saves now surface failures instead of silently dropping the screenshot
  • Drag out: Drag-exporting from the overlay no longer errors on certain destinations
  • Window picker: First click after ⌘⇧5 now reliably selects a window

item.title: Version 1.7.2
item.description:
What's New in 1.7.2

  • Frozen Screen Capture: Area capture now freezes the screen so tooltips, menus, and other transient UI remain visible during selection
  • Overlay Stability: Fixed screen jump when area selector appears
  • Menu Bar Fix: Clicking the menu bar no longer dismisses the area selector

item.title: Version 1.7.1
item.description:
What's Fixed in 1.7.1

  • Tooltips & Menus: Tooltips, dropdown menus, and other transient UI no longer disappear when starting an area capture (⌘⇧4)

item.title: Version 1.7.0
item.description:
What's Fixed in 1.7

  • Hotkeys: No longer intercept Cmd-Shift-3/4/5 unless Screen Recording is available
  • Hotkeys: Recover automatically after Accessibility is granted (no restart needed)
  • Multi-display: Area capture now stitches selections spanning multiple monitors
  • Retina: Crop coordinates correctly mapped to pixel space on Retina displays
  • Undo: Move and resize operations now create undo checkpoints
  • Highlighter: Moving a highlighter annotation now correctly translates the brush path
  • Text editor: Overlay stays aligned when screenshot is letterboxed in the editor
  • Multi-display: Overlay and annotation editor open on the monitor where the capture was taken
  • Option key: Only triggers direct-copy when held as an extra modifier, not when part of a saved shortcut
  • Copy: Copying from the annotation editor no longer silently writes a file for unsaved images
  • Permissions: Alert now guides through both Screen Recording and Accessibility panes when both are missing
  • Launch at login: State now syncs from OS; shows error if toggle fails
  • Canvas: Clicking gray padding outside the image now clears annotation selection
  • Accessibility: Color swatches and icon buttons now have VoiceOver labels

item.title: Version 1.6.0
item.description:
What's New in 1.6

  • Highlighter Tool: New brush-style highlighter in annotation editor (shortcut: H)
  • Follows your drag path with semi-transparent stroke
  • Uses selected color at 40% opacity
  • Brush width scales with stroke width setting

item.title: Version 1.5.0
item.description:
What's New in 1.5

  • Crop Tool: Draw a selection to crop your screenshot, Enter to apply, Escape to cancel
  • Eraser Tool: Click any annotation to remove it (shortcut: X)
  • Drag & Drop: Drag annotated images directly into other apps from the bottom bar

item.title: Version 1.4.0
item.description:
What's New in 1.4

  • Save Control: New option to disable automatic screenshot saving
  • Keyboard Hint: Shows copy shortcut when auto-copy is disabled
  • About Dialog: Cleaner layout with GitHub button

item.title: Version 1.3.0
item.description:
What's New in 1.3

  • Terminal Support: Clipboard now includes file URL for inline image display in Ghostty, iTerm2, etc.
  • Overlay Fix: Screenshot overlay no longer shows square corners at edges
  • About Dialog: Now shows build number for easier debugging

item.title: Version 1.2.1
item.description:
What's New in 1.2.1

  • Bug Fix: Fixed crash when using Copy/Save/Escape in annotation editor

item.title: Version 1.2.0
item.description:
What's New in 1.2

  • About Dialog: New About menu with version info and GitHub link
  • UI Polish: Taller preferences window for better spacing

item.title: Version 1.1.0
item.description:
What's New in 1.1

  • Direct Copy: Hold Option while capturing to copy directly to clipboard (skips overlay)
  • Overlay Position: Choose between bottom-left or bottom-right in Preferences
  • Auto-Updates: Check for Updates from the menu bar
